screener_note: ARK Innovation watchlist screener in TradingView. Fallback: if screener tab is not open, morning.js falls through to the static watchlist array below. Reorder watchlist to prioritize symbols for the fallback path.
pipeline: L1: MOMENTUM-ARK screener (live) → L2: lux_screener_scan 1W (hard filter: BOS + Bullish/Strong Bullish S&O Rating + ▲/▲+ Signal) → L3: NW Envelope per-symbol check on weekly (price inside bands = base coiling, price above upper = extended/already moved)
strategy_note: ARK names are narrative and catalyst-driven — they gap 15-30% on news, base for weeks, then break out again. LuxAlgo BOS on the weekly confirms the broader trend is intact. NW Envelope inside on weekly = price coiling with room to run. NW above upper = the move has already played out. Weekly timeframe same as other equity types.

nw_position_rules.inside: Price inside bands — base coiling, valid entry candidate if R:R ≥ 1:2
nw_position_rules.extended: Price above NW upper band on daily — move already played out, do not enter
nw_position_rules.below_lower: Price below NW lower band — avoid, breakdown in progress

long: Symbol passed L2 hard filter (lux_screener_scan 1D output: score ≥ 0)
NW position = inside (price between lower and upper band on daily)
R:R ≥ 1:2: reward = NW upper band minus price, risk = price minus NW lower band
Manual check: RS vs QQQ positive over last 20 days (stock up more or down less than QQQ)
Manual check: no earnings within 5 trading days — ARK names gap violently on reports

exit_criteria.stop_loss: Below the low of the base (undercut = failed breakout, exit immediately). If base is wide, use the breakout candle low as stop instead.
exit_criteria.failed_breakout: If price closes back below the breakout level on the same day or next — exit immediately. Do not hold through a failed breakout.
exit_criteria.take_profit_1: Scale out 1/3 to 1/2 when price reaches the NW Envelope upper band.
exit_criteria.take_profit_2: Trail remainder using the prior day's low as a trailing stop. Exit if price closes below previous day's low after TP1 hit.
exit_criteria.time_stop: If price does not extend beyond the breakout level within 5 trading days, exit — the move has stalled.

risk_rules: Max 3 open ARK positions — these names are highly correlated (TSLA, COIN, PLTR, NVDA move together in risk-on/off)
Max 1 name per correlation cluster (see asset_notes.correlation_clusters)
Reduce position size 25% vs standard stocks — ARK names are 2-3x beta
Do not enter if NW position = extended
Min R:R 1:2 before entry (NW upper band = reward target)
No entry in first 15 minutes of NYSE open (9:30-9:45 ET)
Never hold through earnings — pre-profit ARK names gap violently on reports
rs_guidance: Relative strength vs QQQ is the primary filter but cannot be read directly from TV indicators in this scan. Approximate it from the quote data: if SPY/QQQ is -2% over 20 days and the stock is -0.5%, it has positive RS. If SPY is +3% and the stock is flat, RS is negative — skip it.

asset_notes.note: Reorder the watchlist to put your highest-conviction names first — only max_symbols are scanned per run.
asset_notes.high_beta_warning: ARK holdings average 2-3x beta vs SPY. A 1% QQQ move = 2-3% move in these names. Size accordingly.
asset_notes.cluster_rule: Do not hold more than one name from the same correlation cluster simultaneously.
